title: Án lệ 64 — ranh giới giữa đòi nợ và bắt cóc
benchmarkBasis: Same accepted audio14.mp3 and words14_aligned.json used by the V15 regression; V16 is independently planned and implemented.

globalVisualContract.editorialOrder: narration meaning -> visual treatment -> authentic evidence/asset -> component
globalVisualContract.palette: charcoal, court-paper cream, evidence orange, restrained rust and cold steel
globalVisualContract.sourceHierarchy: authentic supplied court record first; source-faithful crops for cited facts; anonymous reconstruction only for actions supported by the record
globalVisualContract.camera: stable by default; movement only for context-to-evidence or legal reclassification
globalVisualContract.transition: hard cuts for argument changes; one fade only across the passage-of-days continuation
globalVisualContract.rhythm: physical setting -> coercive mechanism -> documentary proof -> viewer objection -> legal reclassification -> sourced rule

authenticityContract.officialSource: Án lệ số 64/2023/AL, supplied PDF raster excerpts
authenticityContract.reconstructionLimit: anonymous people and warehouse establish only actions expressly supported by the record; they are not portraits of actual participants
authenticityContract.documentRule: never retype source text as evidence; cited excerpts remain raster source and use narration-timed focus regions
